en.headline: Man in intensive care after football strikes chest at Shau Kei Wan playground
en.dek: A 27-year-old man collapsed during a game at around 5pm on Saturday after the ball hit his chest; bystanders used an AED and performed CPR before he was taken to hospital.
body: Police said a 27-year-old man lost consciousness at the Shau Kei Wan Service Reservoir Playground on Yiu Hing Road at about 5pm on Saturday after a football struck his chest during a game.

Bystanders at the scene retrieved an automated external defibrillator from the playground and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation. The man was taken by ambulance to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, where he was placed in the intensive care unit.

His father told reporters that his son’s heart had stopped briefly and that the prompt action by people at the field had restored a pulse and breathing. The father said his son had no known medical conditions and regularly played football.

A cardiologist interviewed by local media said the impact could have triggered a rare condition known as commotio cordis, in which a blow to the chest at a precise moment disrupts the heart’s rhythm. Police are investigating the circumstances.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣男子踢波疑被球擊中胸口昏迷 留醫深切治療部
zh.dek: 一名27歲男子周六下午約5時在配水庫遊樂場踢球時疑被足球擊中胸口後失去知覺，在場人士以AED及心肺復甦法急救後送院。
body: 警方表示，周六下午約5時，一名27歲男子在耀興道筱箕灣配水庫遊樂場草地足球場踢球期間，疑遭足球擊中胸口後當場昏迷。
在場人士即時取用場內自動體外心臟除顫器，並為事主施行心肺復甦法。救護員其後將他送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院，目前仍在深切治療部留醫。
事主父親向傳媒表示，兒子一度心跳停頓，幸得現場有人及時急救，現已恢復呼吸及脈搏。他指兒子過往沒有病痛，並經常踢足球。
有心臟科醫生向本地傳媒分析，撰擊力可能誘發罕見的心臟震盪。警方正調查事件經過。
